mapping.summary: Multi-carrier shipping in BC: rate comparison, booking, labels, tracking, returns and freight invoicing.
claims: Reaches over 2,000 carriers through Cargoson, Sendcloud or Shipmondo
Works with platform rates or the customer's own carrier contracts
Handles parcel, pallet and freight shipments
Compares carrier rates and delivery times before booking
Shipping prices can be checked from a sales order before shipping documents exist
Compares CO2 estimates per carrier via Cargoson
Prepares sustainability journal lines for shipment CO2 as scope 3 data, off by default
Shipping orders from sales, purchase and transfer orders, warehouse shipments and receipts, and posted documents
Batch booking of many orders with a log per run
Lot numbers carried to handling units
Carrier-compliant labels with customs documents when required
HS code and country of origin come from the item card
Labels print automatically to warehouse printers via PrintNode
CMR documents and waybills via Cargoson
Tracking status updates automatically in BC, with webhooks for Shipmondo
Trip shown on a map via Azure Maps
Return shipments booked from return orders, with return labels via Cargoson
Quoted freight costs go onto the order and into sales invoicing
Ships to parcel lockers and service points chosen on the shipping order
Free trial, then Valkonix subscription; Sendcloud and Shipmondo licensed separately
